title: PR body sample excerpt at tick 21 contains a D row the real stream never emits (excerpt is partly fabricated)
evidence: _pr_body.md excerpt (lines 55-61): "P,21,1,1,15,180,180,0,100,1,1,1,5,5,5,0,6,0" ... "D,21,0,0,0,1" "D,21,1,1,0,1"; prose (line 64): "pipe 1 (the return leg) offered 180/cap 15, shed 1 (streaming)." — Actual verified stream (harness run qos_contention --stats-out, two runs byte-identical, stats-check replay-identical), tick 21 block: "G,21,11,3065d3ada10b1ef9,3,100 / C,21,0,... / C,21,1,... / P,21,0,1,15,270,240,1,100,... / P,21,1,1,15,180,180,0,100,... / P,21,2,... / P,21,3,... / D,21,0,0,0,1" — no second D row; pipe 1's P row shows dropped=0 (offered 180 == carried 180). The D,<tick>,1,1,0,1 shape exists at ticks 20 and 22, not 21.
detail: AC6 makes the sample excerpt a deliverable the user reads to SEE and DIFF the artifact; this one merges a neighboring tick's drop line into tick 21 and the prose claim 'pipe 1 shed 1 (streaming)' is false at that tick.
recommended_fix: Regenerate the excerpt verbatim from `harness run qos_contention --stats-out` (e.g. use tick 20 or 22 where both D rows co-occur) and re-verify the prose against it.

title: PR body cites a 'seed column' in the stats stream that the serializer never writes
evidence: _pr_body.md:135: "ticks to the same stream file (tick restarts at 1; the sim_hash + seed column" / "disambiguates runs)." — core/stats.odin:243 header legend: "# G <tick>,<gen>,<sim_hash_hex>,<score>,<meter_pct>\n"; core/stats.odin:253: "fmt.sbprintf(sb, \"G,%d,%d,%016x,%d,%d\\n\"," (tick, gen, sim_hash, score, meter — no seed field).
detail: The documented justification for app-restart append safety references a column that does not exist in the format; only sim_hash disambiguates restarted runs.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body wording to 'the sim_hash disambiguates runs' or add a seed column to the G row.

title: App stats-write failure path omits the spec-mandated exit 1
evidence: spec-5-7-runtime-telemetry.md:72 (I/O matrix): "| `app --stats-out <path>` | flag on launch | app writes the same stream format per stepped tick; written at window close | unwritable path → eprintln + exit 1 |" — app/main.odin:172-174: "if err := os.write_entire_file(app.stats_path, transmute([]u8)strings.to_string(app.stats_sb)); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.eprintfln(\"app: stats stream write failed %s: %v\", app.stats_path, err)\n\t}" (no os.exit(1)).
detail: The frozen spec's error contract for the app stream is 'eprintln + exit 1'; the defer only eprintln's, so a failed write still exits 0.
recommended_fix: After the eprintfln in the defer, call os.exit(1) (before the builder delete, or reorder accordingly).

title: Demo teardown block inlined a third time instead of a shared demo_destroy helper
evidence: harness/overlay.odin:38-45: "for n in d.nodes { delete(n.type_name) } ... delete(d.nodes); delete(d.draws); delete(d.spawns); delete(d.demolishes) ... delete(d.preview_events)" — identical inline block already exists in harness/run.odin:233-254 (run_demo: "for n in demo.nodes { delete(n.type_name) // cloned at parse ..." through "delete(demo.preview_events)") and again in load_demo_replay (~run.odin:615-629).
detail: The new overlay-check verb copy-pastes the Demo string/array teardown a third time; a new Demo field will need three synchronized edits (missed one = leak).
recommended_fix: Extract a demo_destroy(d: ^Demo) proc in harness/demo.odin and call it from all three sites.

title: overlay-check verb missing from the harness usage string; required 'ms' suffix undiscoverable
evidence: harness/main.odin:192: "fmt.eprintln(\"usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo>\")" — no overlay-check; harness/demo.odin:474-476: "parse_ms :: proc(s: string) -> (i64, bool) {\n\tif !strings.has_suffix(s, \"ms\") {\n\t\treturn 0, false". Verified live: `overlay-check qos_contention 3000` prints usage with no hint of the verb or the suffix; `3000ms` works.
detail: The AC3 verification vehicle is undocumented in the binary's own usage; a bare millisecond number fails with no explanation of the required form.
recommended_fix: Mention overlay-check (and its <n>ms argument form) in the usage line for PP_DEBUG builds, or print a specific parse error.

title: App silently ignores a valueless trailing --stats-out flag (harness errors loudly)
detail: A trailing `--stats-out` with no path silently disables the stream (no file, no message), while the harness treats the same malformed invocation as a usage error — asymmetric, catch-and-ignore-shaped.
recommended_fix: If the token is last (i+1 >= len(os.args)), eprintln a usage error and exit before window init, mirroring the harness.
